awsLambda: pack name, used as this pack's metadata namespace
ANY: SAM: catch-all HTTP method on an Api or HttpApi event
SQS: SAM: event source type on a Serverless::Function
event: AWS Lambda: first parameter of the handler signature
context: AWS Lambda: second parameter of the handler signature
statusCode: API Gateway: proxy response envelope field
body: API Gateway: proxy response envelope field
batchItemFailures: AWS Lambda: partial batch response field
